source.note: Generated from Genshin Optimizer sheets (master) + allStat_gen skillParam. Hit keys match GO target paths; multKey = <hitKey>_mult. Levels: Lv10, except constellation-boosted talents of 4-star characters at Lv13 (C6 assumed). Normal/charged/plunging default to physical unless the sheet overrides the element (infusions are NOT applied). Unparsed GO formulas (add manually if needed): ['skill.ringHeal: skipped (helper/cond formula)'].

self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Heart's Repose (A4): Sanctifying Ring's DMG (Grass Ring of Sanctification's periodic ring tick) is increased by 25% of Shinobu's Elemental Mastery (the Healing Bonus portion of this passive is not modeled). Modeled as a flat skill_dmgInc at representative EM values; note this flat add also applies to the ring's initial pressDmg hit since no hit-specific key exists for ringDmg without touching hit_definitions_json (minor overestimate).
C6 To Ward Weakness: when Shinobu's HP drops below 25%, she gains 150 Elemental Mastery for 15s (triggers once every 60s; the death-prevention effect is not damage-relevant and is not modeled).

auto.name: Shinobu's Shadowsword
auto.desc:
<k>Normal Attack</k>
Performs up to 4 rapid strikes.

<k>Charged Attack</k>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

<k>Plunging Attack</k>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skill.name: Sanctifying Ring
skill.desc: Creates a Grass Ring of Sanctification at the cost of part of her HP, dealing Electro DMG to nearby opponents. Grass Ring of Sanctification Follows your current active character around. Deals Electro DMG to nearby opponents every 1.5s and restores HP for active character(s) within the ring's AoE based on Kuki Shinobu's Max HP. The HP consumption from using this skill can only bring her to 20% HP. "Band the Naku Weed into a loop around your waist, and it shall exorcise evil."

burst.name: Gyoei Narukami Kariyama Rite
burst.desc: Stabs an evil-excoriating blade into the ground, creating a field that cleanses the area of all that is foul, dealing continuous Electro DMG to opponents within its AoE based on Shinobu's Max HP. If Shinobu's HP is less than or equal to 50% when this skill is used, the field will last longer. This was originally a technique used in weeding and in ritual prayers for the yearly harvest, but Shinobu has not forgotten it, though her career as a shrine maiden may have ended.

passives.name: Breaking Free
passives.desc: When Shinobu's HP is not higher than 50%, her Healing Bonus is increased by 15%.

passives.name: Heart's Repose
passives.desc:
<k>Sanctifying Ring</k>'s abilities will be boosted based on Shinobu's Elemental Mastery:
· Healing amount will be increased by 75% of Elemental Mastery.
· DMG dealt is increased by 25% of Elemental Mastery.

passives.name: Protracted Prayers
passives.desc: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on an Inazuma Expedition for 20 hours.

constellations.name: To Cloister Compassion
constellations.desc: <k>Gyoei Narukami Kariyama Rite</k>'s AoE is increased by 50%.

constellations.name: To Forsake Fortune
constellations.desc: <k>Grass Ring of Sanctification</k>'s duration is increased by 3s.

constellations.name: To Sequester Sorrow
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Sanctifying Ring</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: To Sever Sealing
constellations.desc:
When the Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks of the character affected by Shinobu's <k>Grass Ring of Sanctification</k> hit opponents, a Thundergrass Mark will land on the opponent's position and deal <e:electro>AoE Electro DMG</e> based on 9.7% of Shinobu's Max HP.
This effect can occur once every 5s.

constellations.name: To Cease Courtesies
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Gyoei Narukami Kariyama Rite</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: To Ward Weakness
constellations.desc:
When Kuki Shinobu takes lethal DMG, this instance of DMG will not take her down. This effect will automatically trigger when her HP reaches 1 and will trigger once every 60s.
When Shinobu's HP drops below 25%, she will gain 150 Elemental Mastery for 15s. This effect will trigger once every 60s.

auto.name: Lame volante
auto.desc:
<k>Attaque normale</k>
Enchaîne jusqu'à 4 coups d'épée.

<k>Attaque chargée</k>
Consomme de l'endurance pour déclencher deux coups d'épée rapides.

<k>Attaque plongeante</k>
Plonge depuis les airs pour frapper le sol, infligeant des DGT aux ennemis en chemin et des DGT de zone à l'impact.

skill.name: Anneau de consécration
skill.desc: Sacrifie une partie des PV pour créer un anneau d'herbes de consécration qui inflige des DGT Électro aux ennemis proches. Anneau d'herbes de consécration Suit le personnage déployé pour infliger des DGT Électro aux ennemis proches et restaurer les PV des personnages déployés à portée d'une valeur proportionnelle aux PV max de Kuki Shinobu, ces deux effets se déclenchant une fois toutes les 1,5 s. Le sacrifice de PV de cette compétence ne fera pas tomber les PV de Kuki Shinobu en dessous de 20 %. Enroulez les herbes à sanglots autour de votre taille et ça exorcisera le mal !

burst.name: Rituel des semoirs de Narukami
burst.desc: Enfonce une lame d'adjuration dans le sol pour créer une barrière qui purifie la zone de tout ce qui est malsain, infligeant de façon continue des DGT Électro aux ennemis à l'intérieur selon les PV max de Kuki Shinobu. Si les PV de Shinobu sont inférieurs ou égaux à 50 % lors de l'utilisation de cette compétence, la barrière dure plus longtemps. C'était à l'origine une technique utilisée pour le désherbage et les prières rituelles en vue des récoltes annuelles, mais Shinobu ne l'a pas oubliée, même si sa vie de prêtresse du sanctuaire est déjà derrière elle.

passives.name: Désir libérateur
passives.desc: Augmente le bonus de soins de 15 % quand les PV de Kuki Shinobu sont inférieurs ou égaux à 50 %.

passives.name: Quiétude du cœur
passives.desc:
L'effet <k>Anneau de consécration</k> s'améliore selon la maîtrise élémentaire de Kuki Shinobu :
· Augmente les soins de 75 % de sa maîtrise.
· Augmente les DGT de 25 % de sa maîtrise.

passives.name: Prière prolongée
passives.desc: Augmente les récompenses d'une expédition de 20 h à Inazuma de 25 %.

constellations.name: Pour cloîtrer la compassion
constellations.desc: La zone d'effet de <k>Rituel des semoirs de Narukami</k> augmente de 50 %.

constellations.name: Pour renier la fortune
constellations.desc: La durée des <k>anneaux d'herbes de consécration</k> augmente de 3 s.

constellations.name: Pour séquestrer le chagrin
constellations.desc:
Niveau d'aptitude <k>Anneau de consécration</k> +3.
Niveau max : 15

constellations.name: Pour rompre le scellement
constellations.desc:
Lorsqu'une attaque normale, chargée ou plongeante d'un personnage affecté par un <k>anneau d'herbes de consécration</k> de Kuki Shinobu touche un ennemi, une marque d'herbes tonitruantes est apposée à l'emplacement de l'ennemi pour infliger des <e:electro>DGT Électro de zone</e> d'une valeur équivalant à 9,7 % des PV max de Shinobu.
Cet effet peut être déclenché une fois toutes les 5 s.

constellations.name: Pour cesser les courtoisies
constellations.desc:
Niveau d'aptitude <k>Rituel des semoirs de Narukami</k> +3.
Niveau max : 15

constellations.name: Pour parer à la faiblesse
constellations.desc:
Lorsque Kuki Shinobu subit des DGT mortels, elle n'est pas vaincue cette fois-ci. Cet effet se déclenche automatiquement lorsque Kuki Shinobu a 1 PV et peut être déclenché une fois toutes les 60 s.
Lorsque les PV de Kuki Shinobu passent sous le seuil des 25 %, sa maîtrise élémentaire augmente de 150 pts pendant 15 s. Cet effet peut être déclenché une fois toutes les 60 s.

auto.name: Lâmina Escondida de Shinobu
auto.desc:
<k>Ataque Normal</k>
Realiza até 4 golpes rápidos.

<k>Ataque Carregado</k>
Consome uma certa quantidade de Stamina para desferir 2 golpes rápidos com a espada.

<k>Ataque Imersivo</k>
Mergulha em pleno ar para golpear o chão, causando Dano aos inimigos ao longo do caminho e infligindo Dano em uma AdE durante o impacto.

skill.name: Anel Santificador
skill.desc: Cria um Anel de Grama Santificada que consome parte da Vida para infligir Dano Electro contra os inimigos ao redor. Anel de Grama Santificada. Segue o personagem ativo no campo de batalha. A cada 1.5s inflige Dano Electro contra os inimigos ao redor e regenera Vida para personagens dentro da AdE do anel no campo de batalha. A quantidade de Vida restaurada é baseada na Vida Máxima de Kuki Shinobu. A Vida consumida para usar essa habilidade não reduzirá a Vida atual de Kuki Shinobu para menos de 20%. Amarre a Erva Naku na sua cintura que ela exorcizará o mal.

burst.name: Ritual Semeador Narukami
burst.desc: Crava uma lâmina expurgadora do mal no chão, criando uma barreira purificadora do mal em frente, infligindo Dano Electro contínuo contra os inimigos dentro dela baseado na Vida Máxima de Kuki Shinobu. Ao lançar essa habilidade, se a Vida de Kuki Shinobu for menor ou igual a 50%, a duração da barreira será prolongada. Originalmente isso era uma técnica usada em capina e em rituais para colheitas anuais. Apesar de sua vida como sacerdotisa ter acabado, Shinobu não esqueceu disso.

passives.name: Ambição Libertadora
passives.desc: Quando a Vida de Kuki Shinobu não for superior a 50%, o Bônus de Cura é aumentado em 15%.

passives.name: Local da Calma
passives.desc:
<k>Anel Santificador</k> obtém os seguintes bônus baseados na Proficiência Elemental de Kuki Shinobu:
· Aumento de Cura baseado em 75% da Proficiência Elemental;
· Aumento de Dano baseado em 25% da Proficiência Elemental.

passives.name: Rezas Prolongadas
passives.desc: Ganha 25% de recompensas a mais quando enviada numa Expedição em Inazuma por 20 horas.

constellations.name: Compaixão Renegada
constellations.desc: Aumenta a AdE de <k>Ritual Semeador Narukami</k> em 50%.

constellations.name: Fortuna Renegada
constellations.desc: Aumenta a duração do <k>Anel de Grama Santificada</k> em 3s.

constellations.name: Dor Renegada
constellations.desc:
Aumenta o nível de <k>Anel Santificador</k> em 3.
O nível máximo de elevação é 15.

constellations.name: Reclusão Renegada
constellations.desc:
Quando o personagem está no estado de <k>Anel de Grama Santificada</k> de Kuki Shinobu e seu Ataque Normal, Ataque Carregado ou Ataque Imersivo atinge o inimigo, uma marca de Grama dos Trovões cairá na posição do adversário, e infligirá <e:electro>Dano Electro em AdE</e> baseado em 9.7% da Vida Máxima de Kuki Shinobu.
Esse efeito pode ocorrer até uma vez a cada 5s.

constellations.name: Sem Cortesia
constellations.desc:
Aumenta o nível de <k>Ritual Semeador Narukami</k> em 3.
O nível máximo de elevação é 15.

constellations.name: Evitando a Fraqueza
constellations.desc:
Quando Kuki Shinobu sofre Dano que pode derrotá-la, esse Dano não a derrotará. Esse efeito será desencadeado automaticamente quando sua Vida atingir 1, e pode ocorrer uma vez a cada 60s.
Quando a Vida de Kuki Shinobu for inferior a 25%, aumentará sua Proficiência Elemental em 150 pontos por 15s. Esse efeito pode ocorrer uma vez a cada 60s.

auto.name: 忍流飞刃斩
auto.desc:
<k>普通攻击</k>
进行至多四段的连续剑击。

<k>重击</k>
消耗一定体力，瞬间向前方挥出两剑。

<k>下落攻击</k>
从空中下坠冲击地面，攻击下落路径上的敌人，并在落地时造成范围伤害。

skill.name: 越祓雷草之轮
skill.desc: 编结越祓草轮，消耗一部分生命值，对周围的敌人造成雷元素伤害。 越祓草轮 将跟随当前场上角色。每1.5秒，对周围的敌人造成雷元素伤害，并为范围内的当前场上角色恢复生命值，回复量受益于久岐忍的生命值上限。 施放该技能所消耗的生命值，至多使久岐忍的生命值降低至20%。 鸣草结环，系于腰际，以驱邪祟。

burst.name: 御咏鸣神刈山祭
burst.desc: 将退邪之刃刺入地面，在前方创造清净邪物的结界，基于久岐忍的生命值上限，对其中的敌人持续造成雷元素伤害。 施放时，若久岐忍的生命值低于或等于50%，结界的持续时间将会延长。 原本是用于割除杂草，祈祷来年丰收的祭祷之术，忍在结束巫女生涯后，也并未将此忘记。

passives.name: 破笼之志
passives.desc: 久岐忍的生命值不高于50%时，治疗加成提升15%。

passives.name: 安心之所
passives.desc:
基于久岐忍的元素精通，<k>越祓雷草之轮</k>获得以下提升：
· 治疗量提升值：元素精通的75%；
· 伤害提升值：元素精通的25%。

passives.name: 久时的祝祷
passives.desc: 在稻妻执行时长为20小时的探索派遣任务时，获得的奖励增加25%。

constellations.name: 割舍怜悯之心
constellations.desc: <k>御咏鸣神刈山祭</k>的影响范围提升50%。

constellations.name: 割舍侥幸之心
constellations.desc: <k>越祓草轮</k>的持续时间延长3秒。

constellations.name: 割舍痛苦之心
constellations.desc:
<k>越祓雷草之轮</k>的技能等级提高3级。
至多提升至15级。

constellations.name: 割舍封闭之心
constellations.desc:
处于久岐忍自己的<k>越祓草轮</k>状态下的角色，在普通攻击、重击或下落攻击命中敌人时，雷草标将落在敌人所在的位置，基于久岐忍生命值上限的9.7%，造成<e:electro>雷元素范围伤害</e>。
该效果每5秒至多触发一次。

constellations.name: 割舍逢迎之心
constellations.desc:
<k>御咏鸣神刈山祭</k>的技能等级提高3级。
至多提升至15级。

constellations.name: 割舍软弱之心
constellations.desc:
久岐忍承受足以使她倒下的伤害时，此次伤害不会使她倒下，这个效果在久岐忍生命值为1时会自动触发，该效果每60秒只能触发一次。
久岐忍生命值降至25%以下时，会提升自身150点精通，持续15秒，该效果每60秒只能触发一次。
